Design the image build, warm pool, and session start for next quarter. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.

Fixed weekly rebuild with no staleness derivation

prompt: Our Modal-based coding agent snapshots the filesystem when a session finishes so users can come back. Restores the session snapshot when it is valid
prohibited_outcomes: Resumes from a warm sandbox that loses session work

Produce the redesigned security-relevant sandbox, identity and PR flow. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Network allowlist at the platform level (e.g. outbound_domain_allowlist, block_network) rather than a command denylist
